# polaris_catalog_role (Data Source)

Reads metadata of an existing Apache Polaris catalog role.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "polaris_catalog_role" "admin" {
  catalog_name = "analytics_catalog"
  name         = "catalog_admin"
}

output "catalog_role_version" {
  value = data.polaris_catalog_role.admin.entity_version
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `catalog_name` (String) The name of the catalog containing the role.
- `name` (String) The name of the catalog role to query.

### Read-Only

- `create_timestamp` (Number) Creation epoch timestamp in milliseconds.
- `entity_version` (Number) Current entity version counter.
- `last_update_timestamp` (Number) Last update epoch timestamp in milliseconds.
- `properties` (Map of String) Custom properties associated with this catalog role.
